units: metres; y up; x = horse's left side; origin on the ground under the girth

Gallop.footfalls: transverse gallop, right lead: LH 0.00, RH 0.10, LF 0.29, RF 0.43 (of the cycle), suspension 0.62-1.00

Canter.footfalls: right lead: LH 0.00, RH 0.20 + LF 0.24, RF 0.42, suspension 0.78-1.00

landmarks.notes: y values are bind-pose heights of joint centres; girthZ = the girth strap's band along z; hoof Z = centre of the ground footprint; legs at x = +-0.13

uv.saddlecloth: Two side panels, each with its own uv in [0,1]^2, upright and unmirrored as seen from that side: v = 0 at the bottom hem, 1 at the spine; u runs left-to-right for the viewer (left panel x>0: u grows towards the tail; right panel: towards the head). The saddle flap and the rider's boot cover roughly v > 0.35 for u < 0.6 (left) / u > 0.4 (right); a race number reads well centred at about (0.80, 0.42) on the left panel and (0.20, 0.42) on the right.
uv.jockey_silks: TEXCOORD_0 (three.js 'uv'): torso = cylinder round the spine, u = 0 at the back centre, 0.25 left side, 0.5 chest centre, 0.75 right side, v = 0 at the waist to 1 at the collar. Sleeves: u round the arm (0 = top of the arm), v = 0 at the shoulder seam to 1 at the cuff. Torso and sleeves each span [0,1]^2; TEXCOORD_1 ('uv1') .x tells them apart: 0 = torso, 1 = left sleeve, 2 = right sleeve.
uv.jockey_cap: u round the head (0 = back, 0.25 = left, 0.5 = front over the peak, 0.75 = right), v = 0 at the brim to 1 at the crown button; the peak (visor) uses v in [0, 0.04].

meshes.tack: saddlecloth, saddle, girth, stirrup leathers + irons, bridle, bit, reins
meshes.jockey_gear: cap cover, goggles, whip (whip uses jockey_boots)
